name: scdaw_load_project
description: Validate and load a complete DAW project schema into the active workbench session, or load an existing project file from ShadowClaw FS / OPFS conversation storage.

filename.description: Project filename to load from conversation files (.scdaw.json, .dawproject, .mid)

conversationId.description: Conversation ID to load from (defaults to 'br:main' / Main)
